author: Dylan Stableford
title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs trial live updates: Cassie Ventura finishes testifying in sex trafficking case - Yahoo
description: The 55-year-old hip-hop mogul has been charged by federal prosecutors with sex trafficking, racketeering conspiracy and transportation to engage in...
content_summary: The high-profile trial of hip-hop mogul Sean "Diddy" Combs wrapped up its first week in Manhattan federal court amid charges including sex trafficking, racketeering conspiracy and transportation to engage in prostitution. Former girlfriend Cassie Ventura, the prosecution's star witness, testified for over 20 hours, describing a decade-long relationship marked by physical abuse and drug-fueled sexual encounters called "freak offs." The defense presented texts suggesting Ventura was a willing participant. Additional witnesses including a Homeland Security agent and singer Dawn Richard testified, the latter recounting witnessing Combs assault Ventura. If convicted, Combs faces life imprisonment and is currently held without bail. The trial is expected to last at least eight weeks. This case has also seen outreach by Combs's allies to Trump officials for a pardon, underscoring the ongoing political dynamics surrounding it.

author: Ellise Shafer
title: Eddington Cannes Premiere: Joaquin Phoenix, Pedro Pascal Get Ovation - Variety
description: "Eddington," Ari Aster's modern Western starring Joaquin Phoenix, Emma Stone, Austin Butler and Pedro Pascal, earned a standing ovation at Cannes.
content_summary: Ari Aster's latest film, "Eddington," a modern Western set during the 2020 pandemic, premiered at Cannes receiving a five-minute standing ovation. The film explores political tensions in a small New Mexico town featuring Joaquin Phoenix and Pedro Pascal. Despite some attendees leaving early, "Eddington" was praised for its provocative social commentary and strong performances. It is scheduled for theatrical release on July 18, 2025.

author: Audrey Rock
title: Chrissy Teigen admits she relapsed on the ‘f–king beast that is alcohol’ in vulnerable post: I’m ‘pissed’ - Page Six
description: “I let it back into my life,” Teigen wrote via Instagram on Thursday. “To let a lot of you down, oh I feel it deeply.”
content_summary: Model and TV personality Chrissy Teigen candidly admitted to a recent relapse in her sobriety journey with alcohol. She described the struggle as battling a 'f--king beast' and expressed deep disappointment while reaffirming her commitment to mindfulness in recovery. Teigen first publicly began her sobriety in 2020 and has openly discussed the challenges and progress she has made since.

author: Ryan Gajewski
title: Ralph Fiennes to Play President Snow in ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ (Exclusive) - The Hollywood Reporter
description: Fiennes is set to portray the diabolical politician who was previously brought to life by the late Donald Sutherland.
content_summary: Acclaimed actor Ralph Fiennes has been cast as President Snow in the upcoming 'Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping,' a prequel film set 24 years before the original series. The film, directed by Francis Lawrence, honors Donald Sutherland's legacy while bringing a fresh perspective to the tyrannical character. The movie is slated for release on November 20, 2026.

author: Asawin Suebsaeng, Cheyenne Roundtree
title: Sean Combs Allies Are Actively Working for a Trump Pardon - Rolling Stone
description: Longtime Diddy associates are already laying the groundwork for a pardon by cozying up to Trump officials.
content_summary: Reports reveal Sean Combs' longtime allies are engaging with Trump officials to seek a presidential pardon amid his ongoing federal trial for serious charges. Despite skepticism from some Trump administration officials about the clemency's feasibility, Combs' team leverages his personal connections with former President Trump, framing the prosecution as politically motivated. The outcome remains uncertain as the trial unfolds.
